failure_summary: 4 of 5 runs never name column 3 in the served prose and none of the 5 emits the REQUIRED [zone:better-col] handle, even though the assembled prompt states 'Better move: column 3 (lands at c3r5)' verbatim (PROMPT.includes('column 3')===true) and lists better-col in its 'You MUST build the explanation around these' block — information was present and unambiguous, so this is prompt_confusion, but note the PRODUCTION-FIDELITY caveat: these rows are gpt-5.4-mini (the shipped model), so prompt defect cannot be separated from model capability here.

counterexamples.evidence: The assembled prompt (assembleGroundedPrompt) contains 'Better move: column 3 (lands at c3r5)' and lists '[zone:better-col] = the column of the better move' under 'You MUST build the explanation around these', yet none of the 5 served explanations emits [zone:better-col] and 4 of 5 never write 'column 3'; note render_decision.requiredSet itself lists only opp-major and opp-major-line, so the required-set record disagrees with the prompt block the model was shown.

Run 0's 'the tougher block' has no locatable referent: the better move is column 3 landing at c3r5 on the decision board 33211333455011222, while the block it is equated with is c1r4, occupied only at ply 24 of lostResource.finalMovestring 332113334550112222341000.
